mercedes-amg-gt-2023.tagline: A hand-built grand tourer with the soul of a racer.
mercedes-amg-gt-2023.description: This AMG GT Coupé pairs a front-mid V8 with a track-honed chassis for a driving experience that is as composed on the boulevard as it is thrilling on an open road. Finished in Graphite Grey with a carbon-trimmed cabin and Burmester sound, it has covered minimal distance and presents as new.

porsche-911-carrera-2024.tagline: The definitive sports car, now in its most refined form.
porsche-911-carrera-2024.description: A brand-new 911 Carrera S in striking Lava Orange. Sport Chrono, active PASM suspension and a sports exhaust make every drive an occasion, while everyday usability remains unmistakably 911. Delivered with full principal documentation.

lamborghini-huracan-2022.tagline: A naturally-aspirated V10 that redefines occasion.
lamborghini-huracan-2022.description: The Huracán EVO delivers one of the last great naturally-aspirated V10s, paired with all-wheel drive and Lamborghini's dynamic integration system. Presented in Arancio Borealis with forged wheels and a documented, low-mileage history.

bmw-m4-competition-2023.description: The M4 Competition blends a 3.0L twin-turbo straight-six with M xDrive traction and a carbon roof. A focused yet usable coupé with a full service record and Harman Kardon audio.

mercedes-s-class-2024.description: A brand-new S 500 L with the executive rear lounge, MBUX Hyperscreen and AIRMATIC air suspension. Serene, technologically advanced and beautifully finished in Obsidian Black.

porsche-718-cayman-2023.tagline: Mid-engine balance in its purest form.
porsche-718-cayman-2023.description: A 718 Cayman GTS with the flat-six engine and a genuine manual gearbox — a driver's car in the truest sense. Racing Yellow over black, with Sport Chrono and BOSE audio.

mercedes-g-class-2023.tagline: An icon that answers to no one.
mercedes-g-class-2023.description: The G 63 AMG unites a hand-built biturbo V8 with genuine off-road capability and unmistakable presence. Finished in Obsidian Black with a Nappa leather cabin and adaptive damping.

tesla-model-s-plaid-2024.description: A brand-new Model S Plaid with tri-motor all-wheel drive, long-range battery and a panoramic glass roof. Instant, silent acceleration paired with genuine day-to-day range.

bmw-m5-2022.description: The M5 Competition offers 617 hp, M xDrive and a Merino leather cabin — supercar pace wrapped in a five-seat saloon. Well-maintained with a documented history and head-up display.

audi-rs7-sportback-2023.description: The RS7 Sportback combines a mild-hybrid V8, quattro grip and Bang & Olufsen 3D audio in a fastback silhouette. Daytona Grey with adaptive air suspension and Matrix LED lighting.

range-rover-autobiography-2024.tagline: The last word in luxury travel.
range-rover-autobiography-2024.description: A brand-new Range Rover Autobiography with Executive Class rear seating, Meridian audio and cabin air purification. Commanding, refined and endlessly capable in Santorini Black.

chevrolet-camaro-ss-2021.description: A Camaro SS with the 6.2L V8, a manual gearbox and Magnetic Ride Control. Rally Red with Brembo brakes and a dual-mode exhaust — a characterful modern classic with a clear history.

about.title: Luxury cars, chosen the way we'd choose our own
about.lead: AURUM is a curated showroom built on a simple idea: buying a beautiful car should feel as good as owning one.
about.imageAlt: A luxury car in a refined showroom setting

story.title: Our story
story.p1: AURUM began with a frustration shared by every enthusiast — that buying a special car is too often stressful, opaque and full of pressure. We wanted to do the opposite.
story.p2: So we built a showroom around curation and honesty. We hand-pick each car, inspect it independently, document it fully, and list it exactly as it is. If a car isn't good enough for us, it isn't good enough for you.
story.p3: Everything runs through one personal point of contact by email, so you always know who you're talking to. No queues, no scripts — just straight answers.

compliance.title: How we protect you
compliance.lead: We can't promise what we can't deliver — so here are the concrete, honest practices behind every AURUM listing.

inspection.title: Independent inspection
inspection.body: Each car receives a multi-point mechanical and cosmetic inspection. Any known faults are disclosed in the listing.

documents.title: Complete documents
documents.body: We verify ownership and vehicle documents before listing, and hand over a complete set at purchase.

privacy.title: Data protection
privacy.body: We collect only what we need to answer your enquiry and never sell your data. See our privacy policy for details.

transparency.title: Honest listings
transparency.body: Specifications, mileage and condition are presented as accurately as we can. If something changes, we update it.

payment.title: Secure transactions
payment.body: Payments are made through traceable, official channels. We never ask for cash to informal accounts.

warranty.title: Clear after-sale terms
warranty.body: Any warranty or after-sale support offered on a specific car is stated in writing before you commit.

disclaimer.title: About this website
disclaimer.body: AURUM is a demonstration showroom. The brand, the listed cars, prices, mileage and stock shown here are illustrative sample data for showcasing the website, not a live commercial offer. No purchase can be completed through this site — enquiries are handled personally by email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and how we protect it.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: AURUM is a demonstration showroom website. This policy describes how personal data would be handled when you contact us through the website or by email.
Because AURUM is a placeholder project, no live commercial data processing takes place beyond replying to messages you choose to send.

sections.heading: Data we collect
paragraphs: When you submit the contact form we collect the name, email and any phone number and message you provide.
When you email us, your message and the address you send it from are visible to us in our mailbox, subject to your own email provider's terms.
We do not use advertising trackers. A cookie is used only to remember your language preference.

sections.heading: How we use your data
paragraphs: We use the details you provide solely to respond to your enquiry and to arrange any viewing or purchase you request.
We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep enquiry details only for as long as needed to assist you, after which they are deleted on request.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us using the details on the contact page.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For any privacy question, contact us via the channels listed on the contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lead: By using this website you agree to the following terms.

sections.heading: Nature of this website
paragraphs: AURUM is a demonstration showroom. The brand name, vehicles, prices, mileage and availability shown are illustrative sample data used to showcase the website's design and features.
Nothing on this website constitutes a binding offer, contract, or professional advice.

sections.heading: No online transactions
paragraphs: No sale or payment can be completed through this website. All enquiries are handled personally by email, and any real transaction would be governed by a separate written agreement.

sections.heading: Accuracy of information
paragraphs: We aim to keep information accurate but make no warranty that it is complete or error-free. Car specifications and availability may change without notice.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The website design and content are provided for demonstration purposes. Vehicle marques and model names are the trademarks of their respective owners and are used for identification only.

sections.heading: External links
paragraphs: This website links to third-party services such as Instagram. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of external services.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always available on this page.
